home.whatYouDo: What you are in charge of

mbos.summary: You manage the whole system: users, roles and the menus each one sees. You can see every warehouse and account movement.
tasks: Create users and assign their role
Decide which menus each role sees
Review the financial summary and all reports

tesorero.summary: You look after the money and authorize changes. You follow the warehouse and the accounts, and approve or reject the edits and voids others request.
tasks: Approve or reject edits and voids of receipts and issues
Follow accounts receivable and this month's collections

contador.summary: You keep the warehouse accounting: what comes in, what goes out and what it is worth. You also authorize the edits and voids the Accounting Assistant requests.
tasks: Review the kardex, stock and reports

auxiliar.summary: You record the warehouse day to day: purchases and receipts, issues to pastors and transfers between warehouses. You keep clients, suppliers and products up to date.
tasks: Add and correct clients, suppliers and products
Ask the Accountant or Treasurer to edit or void a record

pastor.summary: You check your own account: the material you were given and what you still owe.

caja.summary: You receive accounts receivable payments and record each deposit, product by product.
tasks: See which accounts are still pending
